Value profile used for this panel: access=0.2, adaptability=0.4, continuity=0.8, oversight=0.6, safety=0.5. Values keeping essential operations moving through disruption. Prioritizes conservative safeguards when consequences are uncertain. Has no fixed preference for expanding or narrowing access. Values controls that make exceptions auditable. [group-49fdbb40] Customer coordinators: Want continuity and timely delivery updates. Value profile used for this panel: access=0.8, adaptability=0.4, continuity=0.9, oversight=0.1, safety=0.3.
